title: My White Kite
lines: A big puff lifts it up and up.
The kite lands in a tall pine.
"My kite!" said Mike. "I can not get it."
Jill rolls up on a bike and stops.
Mike grabs a long stick from the grass.
He taps the kite and it slips off!
Mike and Jill ride off with a smile.

questions.listenFor: In a tall pine tree. If they say "a tree," that counts, but ask which line told them.

questions.ask: How does Mike get the kite down?
questions.listenFor: He taps it with a long stick until it slips off. Lines six and seven say it. Let them find the word stick.

questions.ask: Do you think Mike and Jill are pals? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason from the story, like "yes, they ride off together at the end."
